title: Sheikh El Balad
service: Social media campaign, menu photography direction, post system
blurb: A food brand that lives on tradition, not trends. Deep burgundy, gold Arabic type and one hero dish per post — the whole campaign reads like a family recipe card rather than an ad.
alt: Sheikh El Balad social media campaign posters with burgundy and gold Arabic typography
details: Post template set of 9 formats covering offers, dishes, hours and occasions.
Type pairing: a display Arabic face for the hook, one light face for the supporting line — never three.
Every post carries a single call-to-action number, consistent across the whole feed.
